problem: Defect B's real root cause, finally isolated: the frozen evaluator DOES NOT TERMINATE on a large minority of the corpus. Evidence: 10 sweep children pegged at 99.9 percent CPU with only 111-946 MB RSS for 34-62 minutes each, zero completions; separately two cases OOM-killed above 25 GB. This is not slowness and not a memory bug -- befca0d s2.10 states it outright: 'simplify is unbounded in the worst case.' The frozen evaluator calls g2_contract's sympy.simplify with NO cost cap, unlike the production classifier e2_classify.py which has always enforced SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5 at a process boundary and which produced the v1 69/57 baseline itself.
diagnosis: A per-expression cap is unavoidable to make ANY progress, yet frozen authority forbids the naive cap: befca0d s2.10 requires it be 'recorded as an explicit SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT status rather than silently becoming None', and a timeout must never stand in for a class.
repair: Built scripts/e2b_bounded_determinacy_evaluator.py, which never converts a cap into a classification. Each row resolves to CORRECT / INCORRECT / UNRESOLVED, and the case is assigned a class ONLY IF the frozen four-way decision tree returns the same class under EVERY consistent resolution of the UNRESOLVED rows -- evaluated by enumerating the (at most 3) still-open booleans the tree actually reads (representative_correct, seeds_with_correct_on_front>0, seeds_with_retained_correct>=1). Where the class is invariant it is the frozen evaluator's own answer established with certainty; where it is not, the case is reported INDETERMINATE_UNDER_BOUND rather than guessed.
validation: A REAL BUG IN THIS TOOLING WAS FOUND AND FIXED BEFORE USE: the cap exception initially derived from Exception, which g2_contract's six `except Exception: return None` handlers would have swallowed, silently turning a cap into not-correct -- exactly the prohibited behaviour. It now derives from BaseException (verified: g2_contract contains no bare `except:`), so a cap is always visible as UNRESOLVED. Validated 8/8 against uncapped frozen ground truth on cases spanning all four classes, reproducing both intermediate seed statistics exactly. Proven to actually fire: PB|held_out|F03|r011 -- which OOM-killed both evaluators and ran over an hour uncapped -- resolves in 43.4s with 9 of 388 rows UNRESOLVED and a DETERMINED class of LOST_IN_CROSS_SEED.
